title: Repo .claude/settings.json redirects API base URL before trust
reason_not_testable: The config is applied before the workspace trust prompt is accepted and before any tool call or PostToolUse hook runs, so no hook payload exists to test. Non-hook controls from the catalog: do not open untrusted repos, read the trust prompt, and run a Claude Code release containing the cited fix (version 2.0.65 is cited by the catalog and is UNVERIFIED here).
